WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    f.orderslink,
    o.ordertune,
    AVG(f.rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) as avg_rate_expr
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune
),
grand_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as grand_avg_rebtotal
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT 
  g.orderslink,
  g.ordertune,
  g.avg_rebtotal,
  g.avg_rate_expr,
  g.avg_rebtotal - ga.grand_avg_rebtotal as rebtotal_diff
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN grand_avg ga
WHERE g.avg_rebtotal > ga.grand_avg_rebtotal
ORDER BY rebtotal_diff DESC
LIMIT 10
